description: This file defines a React functional component 'ToolTestPanel' that provides a user interface for testing a specific tool. It includes input parameter forms, displays tool execution results, copying functionalities, and status indicators.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission by converting input values according to their schema types, wrapping nested parameters if needed, and invoking the onSubmit callback.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Attempts to copy specified text to the clipboard using modern Clipboard API with fallback to execCommand, and reports success or failure.

methods.name: handleCopyResult
methods.description: Copies the current result JSON to clipboard and shows success or failure notification.

methods.name: handleCopyToolName
methods.description: Copies the tool's name to clipboard and shows success or failure notification.
